description: Pattern (c27): a command that needs the person (a force push; the folder is not a repository, so even a mistaken run only fails) and the person answers the pending question in their own words, not the scripted approver's fixed sentences: "그냥 해" must run exactly that command once, "아니 잠깐" must settle it as declined and nothing runs. The first turn must not run anything (the question is open). Needs the decision composition (--decisions with a key): the reply is read as two yes/no predicates. Expectations are code checks only.

folder.README.md: scratch folder for the real-engine check

turns.say: Run this command: git push --force origin main
